result_assessed: 3-point MACE (CV death, nonfatal MI, nonfatal stroke), hazard ratio, effect of assignment (ITT)

D1_randomisation.why: Sequestered, fixed randomisation schedule (concealed), matching placebo, 1:1.

witnesses.span: Patients were assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive subcutaneous injections of albiglutide or 179 matching placebo once weekly, according to a sequestered, fixed, randomisation schedule.

D2_deviations_assignment.why: All randomised patients analysed whether or not treatment was taken (ITT), matching placebo.

witnesses.span: These analyses included all patients randomly assigned to study 236 treatment, whether taken or not, and followed to the study closure visit (or final date vital 237 status could be ascertained).
Vital status was not known for 61 of 9463 participants (0.6%) (Figure 293 1).

D4_outcome_measurement.why: Independent clinical events classification committee unaware of trial-group assignments.

witnesses.span: An independent clinical events classification committee whose members were 210 unaware of the trial-group assignments adjudicated all the components of the primary 211 composite outcome

D5_selection_of_reported_result.why: The Reporting and Analysis Plan (based on protocol amendment 3, 04-Apr-2017) specifies time to first MACE as the primary analysis, before database freeze.

witnesses.span: This RAP is based on protocol amendment 3 (Dated: 04-APR-2017)
Time to first occurrence of MACE (cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, or stroke) The primary analysis will be non-inferiority.
